uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

2105-5144-5434-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5144-5434-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5144-5434-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

240-3480-3899-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

676-3259-4460.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-3259-4460.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater

2436-4644-7791.description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Marwyn.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Marwyn.
Repeat.

3609-6750-7704.notablePrerequisites: Inspirit has one or more charge counters on it.
3609-6750-7704.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Inspirit triggers, putting three charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1116-4050-4484-6896.easyPrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
1116-4050-4484-6896.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} due to Green Goblin.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ebondeath, adding {B}.
When Ebondeath dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2173-2459-5220-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Rograkh
When Rograkh dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Rograkh from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Rograkh from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

4968-6260-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Deathbringer Thoctar.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Deathbringer Thoctar triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Caradora.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
4968-6260-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

1283-1987-4423-6650.easyPrerequisites:
You control three additional Islands.
The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
1283-1987-4423-6650.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Chromatic Orrery by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Chromatic Orrery.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

1274-4186-6720.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-4186-6720.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

104-1495.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 2 life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelion.
Repeat.

578-1029-5028.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact card in hand.
578-1029-5028.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, revealing at least one artifact card from your hand and adding at least {C}{C}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Metalworker.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
578-1029-5028.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

800-1355-4116.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
800-1355-4116.description:
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Sanctum Weaver.
Activate Volrath by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}, causing it to become a copy of Knacksaw Clique.
Activate Volrath by paying {1}{U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of an opponent's library with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Repeat.

826-1636-3967-6243.easyPrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-1636-3967-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing another nontoken creature you control to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature targeted in step 1.
When the creature dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield as a white Angel.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2558-4779-4848-5687.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Domri, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

813-3603-5195.description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Scholar of the Ages
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Scholar of the Ages
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Cloudshift to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

1405-2923-5686.notablePrerequisites: An opponent's life total is higher than or equal to your life total.
1405-2923-5686.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Scourge of the Throne from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving it haste until end of turn.
Declare Scourge of the Throne as an attacker, attacking an opponent whose life total is higher than or equal to yours.
Scourge of the Throne's dethrone ability and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger, causing you to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Scourge of the Throne.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger from step 3, doing nothing.
Repeat each combat phase.

957-3662-3942.manaNeeded: {8}{U}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {3}{R}{R}{R} each other extra turn
957-3662-3942.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Activate Izzet Chemister's first ability by paying {R} and tapping it, exiling Time Stretch from your graveyard.
Move to your second extra turn.
Activate Izzet Chemister's second ability by paying {1}{R}, tapping and sacrificing it, casting Time Stretch from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Time Stretch, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Cast Izzet Chemister from your graveyard by paying {2}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of the creature with persist.

3388-3967--5.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Moritte of the Frost.
When Moritte of the Frost dies, it triggers its persist ability, returning itself to the battlefield as a copy of the creature with persist with two +1/+1 counters and one -1/-1 counter on it.
Remove one +1/+1 counter and one -1/-1 counter from Moritte of the Frost as a state-based action.
Resolve the activated ability from step 1, giving Yahenna indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

1242-1323-2085-3143.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj and Xavier Sal do not have summoning sickness.
Cinderhaze Wretch and Kelpie Guide each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one creature token.
1242-1323-2085-3143.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from Experiment Kraj, creating a copy of any creature token you control.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Kelpie Guide's first ability by tapping it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

1409-2608-4306.notablePrerequisites:
Deadeye Navigator is paired with Derevi.
Your devotion to blue is at least three.
1409-2608-4306.description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Derevi enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Derevi trigger, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Derevi.
Repeat.

23-776-1329-1834.notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Vandal do not have summoning sickness.
23-776-1329-1834.description:
Tap Orcish Vandal, sacrificing Briber's Purse to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Briber's Purse.
Cast Briber's Purse.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
